statement: A host whose web adapter takes its caller from the `CoSec-Identity` header (the three cases of `STA-6`) believes any such header it receives, and the header carries no signature, so the network is the boundary. It fails to start unless the operator states what can reach it, `cosec.pipeline.identity.only-gateway-can-reach` or `cosec.pipeline.identity.only-trusted-callers-can-reach` (`STA-9`) written `true` (any letter case, nothing else: absent, empty, `false`, `1` and `on` fail alike), with a message that says what the host trusts and that it contains mistakes and keeps the audit but does not defend against a compromised workload that can reach it, what must be true of the network (a NetworkPolicy, mutual TLS or a private network) and the exact lines to add. When it is set the startup logs one INFO line, not a warning. A host that takes its callers from the credentials it verifies needs none.
guards: spring-boot:GatewayModeTrustTest#a service in gateway mode does not start until the operator states the boundary, and the message says what to write
spring-boot:GatewayModeTrustTest#false and every value but true fail like an absent one, and say what was written
spring-boot:GatewayModeTrustTest#with the statement the service starts, in any letter case of true, and an enforcing host needs none
spring-boot:GatewayModeTrustTest#a reactive service is held to the same two statements
spring-boot:ControlManifestsTest#the control directory does not state the boundary, and either statement there is reported
spring-boot:ControlManifestsTest#an overlay states the boundary beside the check, and the dev overlay says first that it is unsafe on a shared cluster
spring-boot:ControlManifestsTest#a check that a policy admits, that leaves out a port, or that cannot find a pod that is not ready is reported
spring-boot:ForwardedIdentityCallerTest#it does not start until the operator states what can reach it, and either statement will do
spring-boot:ForwardedIdentityCallerTest#an identity gate the application wires beside enforce is asked for the statement too
